dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, tomorrow our class is visiting a laboratory in the science faculty.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, təˈmɑːroʊ aʊr ˈklæs ɪz ˈvɪzɪtɪŋ ə ˈlæbrətɔːri ɪn ðə ˈsaɪəns ˈfækəlti.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? What are they working on?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈwʌt ər ðeɪ ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ˈɑːn?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: The development of a new rice that needs less water.
dialogue.reading: ðə dɪˈvɛləpmənt əv ə ˈnuː ˈraɪs ðæt ˈniːdz ˈlɛs ˈwɔːtər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's a great idea for the dry season. Will we see an experiment?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈɡreɪt aɪˈdiːə fər ðə ˈdraɪ ˈsiːzən. wɪl wiː ˈsiː ən ɪkˈspɛrɪmənt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. They'll show us an experiment with young rice plants.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðeɪl ˈʃoʊ ʌs ən ɪkˈspɛrɪmənt wɪð ˈjʌŋ ˈraɪs ˈplænts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Is the new rice better than the old rice?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðə ˈnuː ˈraɪs ˈbɛtər ðən ði ˈoʊld ˈraɪs?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's a big improvement. It grows well with half the water.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ə ˈbɪɡ ɪmˈpruːvmənt. ɪt ˈɡroʊz ˈwɛl wɪð ˈhæf ðə ˈwɔːtər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Is there a possibility that farmers can use it soon?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðɛr ə ˌpɑːsəˈbɪləti ðæt ˈfɑːrmərz kən ˈjuːz ɪt ˈsuːn?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Maybe in a few years. Development takes time.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi ɪn ə ˈfjuː ˈjɪrz. dɪˈvɛləpmənt ˈteɪks ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I can't wait to see the lab!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈkænt ˈweɪt tə ˈsiː ðə ˈlæb!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And remember: in a lab, you mustn't touch anything!
dialogue.reading: ənd rɪˈmɛmbər: ɪn ə ˈlæb, juː ˈmʌsənt ˈtʌtʃ ˈɛniθɪŋ!
